key_insight: AI-related clinical trials have significantly increased over time, with notable growth in specific AI technologies.
clinical_relevance: Understanding trends in AI in clinical trials can enhance the integration of AI technologies in healthcare research.
method: Analyzed records from ClinicalTrials.gov focusing on AI terminology.
Used a hybrid human-AI approach combining GPT-5.5 with human review.
Classified 100 records to assess AI usage and human-AI interactions.
evidence_signal: China and the US lead in AI trial registrations, with emerging increases in several European countries.
watch_item: Variable accuracy in classifying human-AI interactions, especially when descriptions are unclear.
paper_title: Trends in AI and Human-AI Interaction in Clinical Trials -- A Hybrid Human-AI Exploration
